result.summary: Exposes assumeutxo snapshot loading and metadata access via a new `interfaces::Snapshot` class on `interfaces::Node`, and introduces a progress notification signal during snapshot population. It refactors the `loadtxoutset` RPC to delegate file opening, parsing, and activation through this interface instead of calling internal chainstate methods directly.
result.problem: UTXO snapshot loading is tied directly to `ChainstateManager` and internal file helpers inside the `loadtxoutset` RPC handler without an interface abstraction. GUI frontends and multiprocess clients cannot initiate snapshot loading or display progress as coins are validated and populated into the chainstate.
evidence: PR description: 'This PR implements a complete interface for loading UTXO snapshots through the GUI, including progress notifications to provide user feedback during the loading process.'
PR description links to GUI implementations: bitcoin-core/gui#870 and bitcoin-core/gui-qml#488
result.scope_notes: Note that error codes returned by `loadtxoutset` for file-opening and metadata-parsing failures change from `RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER` (-8) and `RPC_DESERIALIZATION_ERROR` (-22) to `RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR` (-32603), as reflected in the updated functional test.
result.changed_since_previous: Unified error reporting in the `loadtxoutset` RPC handler to consistently return `RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR` for failures during activation, updating `feature_assumeutxo.py` assertions accordingly.
result.card: Adds a Snapshot interface to interfaces::Node and introduces a progress notification signal during UTXO snapshot loading. This enables external clients, such as GUI frontends and IPC wrappers, to initiate assumeutxo snapshot activation and receive real-time progress updates while coins are being loaded. It also refactors the loadtxoutset RPC to use the interface, moving file validation into the snapshot implementation. This change unblocks draft GUI PRs bitcoin-core/gui#870 and bitcoin-core/gui-qml#488.

risk.why: A flaw in snapshot activation forwarding or progress signaling could abort UTXO snapshot loading or alter RPC error codes expected by existing automation.
